newsitem.title: USA: Excite files with SEC for 2.3 mln offer.
newsitem.headline: Excite files with SEC for 2.3 mln offer.

text.p: Excite Inc filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2.3 million common shares.
The company granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to buy an additional 345,000 common shares. The offering will be made through Robertson, Stephens & Co and Merrill Lynch & Co.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 13,804,417 common and 2,630,330 shares of preferred (convertible into common stock on a one-for-one basis).
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital, which may include strategic acquisitions of complementary products, businesses and technologies.
Excite first announced it was planning on selling 2.3 million shares on February 28 and had said they were going to file with the SEC the week of March 3.
Excite Inc, based in Mountain View, Calif., provides a gateway to the World Wide Web that organizes, aggregates and delivers information to meet the needs of individual customers.
